title: Measured least-model Horn SAT in the pinned reference encoding
claims: ExactHornSAT establishes P membership for the exact canonical satisfiable Horn-CNF language.
MeasuredHornSAT implements least-model closure in the reference machine model and proves correctness on canonical Horn formulae.
HornClosureCompleteness checks the finite closure correctness and least-model property.
MeasuredHornGuard recognizes the exact canonical Horn syntax language.
